payload.purpose_context: Users run AI coding agents in the background. Bitz should notice any popular agent working and pop up a speech bubble when it is done or waiting for approval, via process detection plus per-agent hooks/log watchers, with no Accessibility permissions and user-defined custom agents. Tracks GitHub issue #1.
payload.purpose_tldr: Bitz detects running AI agents (Claude, Gemini, Antigravity, Codex, Cursor, etc.) and shows a popup when they finish or need approval.
